legalNotice.message: DramaFetch is for personal, offline viewing of episodes that your own TikTok account can already watch. It does not unlock paid episodes and does not bypass DRM or access controls; locked episodes are listed and skipped. Downloading may breach TikTok's Terms of Service, and the videos belong to their creators and studios — you are responsible for how you use this tool.

Descargar puede infringir las Condiciones del servicio de TikTok, y los videos pertenecen a sus creadores y estudios — eres responsable de cómo usas esta herramienta.
